title: RNA Extraction and Purification from Cultured Diatom Viruses
author: Pauline Nogaret
materials: Extraction of 500µL viral nucleic acids using MasterPure Complete DNA & RNA Purification Kit (Epicentre). Cellular lysis: Split in two tubes 250µL of viral sample : "tube 1" and "tube 2". This two tubes will be pooled and the end of extraction for concentration. Thoroughly mix the several buffers to homogenize them before dispensing. Dilute 4μL of Proteinase K into 600μL of 2X T and C Lysis Solution. Vortex 10s. Add 250µL of 2X T and C Lysis Solution containing the Proteinase K to each tube of viral sample and mix thoroughly. Incubate at 65°C for 15 minutes in a Eppendorf thermomixer at 1000rpm with smartblock 1,5mL. Place the samples on ice for 5 minutes to inactivate the proteinase K. Nucleic acids precipation and extraction : Add 250 μL of MPC Protein Precipitation Reagent to 500 μL of lysed sample. Vortex vigorously for 10 seconds. Centrifuge. 11000 x g, 12 °C, 10 minutes Transfer the supernatant to a clean microcentrifuge tube and discard the pellet. Centrifuge. 11000 x g, 12 °C, 10 minutes Transfer the supernatant to a clean microcentrifuge tube and discard the pellet. Add 840 μL of cold isopropanol to the recovered supernatant. Invert tubes 40 times. Centrifuge tubes to pellet the total nucleic acid. 20800 x g, 12 °C, 10 minutes Carefully pour off the isopropanol without dislodging the pellet. Contaminating DNA digestion with DNase : Prepare DNAse I solution (1/40) : 10µL Rnase Free Dnase I into 390µL Dnase Buffer. Completely resuspend the total nucleic acid pellet in 200 μL of DNase I solution (1/40). Incubate at 37°C for 10 minutes. Add 200 μL of 2X T and C Lysis Solution. Vortex for 5 seconds. Add 200 μL of MPC Protein Precipitation Reagent. Vortex 10 secondes. Place on ice for 4 minutes. Centrifuge 11000 x g, 12 °C, 10 minutes to pellet the debris. Transfer the supernatant containing the RNA into a clean microcentrifuge tube and discard the pellet. Centrifuge 11000 x g, 12 °C, 3 minutes keep and transfer the supernatant into a new tube. Add 840µL of cold isopropanol to the supernatant. Invert tubes 40 times. Centrifuge 20800 x g, 12 °C, 10 minutes and discard supernatant. RNA precipitation: Rinse twice with cold 70% ethanol, being careful to not dislodge the pellet. Centrifuge. 11000 x g, 12 °C, 30 seconds Remove all the ethanol by pipetting and keep at room temperature the tube open during 10 minutes for the ethanol evaporation . Resuspend the total nucleic acids (RNA) of "tube 1" in 35 μL of TE Buffer. Re use this solution for resuspend the total nucleic acids of the "tube 2" in the aim of concentrate sample. Keep 2µl for Qubit quantification and store RNA extract at -80°C.

By sample, add in 0,2 ml microtube : 1µL Random primers (250ng) 11µL RNA extract (Total RNA should range between 10pg - 5µg - complete with RNA-free water if necessary) 1µL 10mM dNTP qsp 13µL : Add Nuclease Free water to complete. Thermocycler parameter : 65°C 5min. 2min in ice. In the same microtube, add : 4µL 5X First strand buffer 1µL 0,1M DTT 2µL Superscript III RT (400U/µl) 1µL RNAse OUT Recombinant Rnase Inhibitor. Thermocycler parameter : 25°C 10min > 50°C 60min > 70°C 15min. Store cDNA at -20°C.

steps.title: Prepare Infected Diatom Culture
steps.instruction: Grow one liter of diatom host culture exponentially in K+Si medium at 18 °C under a 12:12 h light:dark cycle with an irradiance of 100 µmol photons·m⁻²·s⁻¹ (white fluorescent light, Philips Master TL-D 18W/865).

substeps.instruction: Add a freshly produced viral lysate, filtered through a 0.45 µm PES membrane, to the host culture at a final concentration of 10–20% (v/v).
Incubate the infected culture under the same conditions as the host culture until complete lysis is observed.

steps.title: Clarify Viral Lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the viral lysate (2x500mL) at 5353 x g and 4 °C for 30 minutes using an Avanti J-25XP (Beckman Coulter-JA-10 Rotor).

substeps.instruction: Carefully transfer the supernatant into a 0.45 µm filtration unit (Stericup), avoiding disturbance of the pellet.
Filter the supernatant completely using a hand pump.

steps.title: Concentrate Viral Lysate
steps.instruction: Concentrate the clarified viral lysate to 50 mL using a Vivaflow 200 cartridge (30 kDa MWCO, PES, Sartorius).

substeps.instruction: Further concentrate the sample to ~1 mL using a Vivaspin 20 (30 kDa MWCO, PES, Cytiva) by centrifugation at 6000 x g and 4 °C for 10 minutes.
Keep the Vivaspin at 4 °C overnight.
Rinse the Vivaspin 20 by adding 1 mL of 10 mM phosphate solution and transfer the rinse to the Falcon tube containing the sample.
Repeat the rinsing step until a final volume of 10 mL is reached.

steps.title: Purify Viruses with Chloroform
steps.instruction: Perform chloroform extraction under a chemical hood to purify the sample.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 volume of chloroform (10 mL) to the Falcon tube containing the sample.
Vortex thoroughly.
Centrifuge at 2200 x g and 12 °C for 3 hours (03:00:00).
Carefully transfer the upper aqueous phase containing viruses into a new Falcon tube.
Repeat the addition of 1 volume of chloroform, vortexing, and centrifugation a total of 7 times.
Leave the tube (containing 5 mL of sample) open overnight under the chemical hood to evaporate residual chloroform.

steps.title: Final Viral Concentration and Washing
steps.instruction: Concentrate and wash the purified sample using a Vivaspin 20.

substeps.instruction: Concentrate the sample to 1 mL using a Vivaspin 20 at 6000 x g and 12 °C for 5 minutes.
Collect the sample and add 1 mL of nuclease-free water.
Centrifuge in the same Vivaspin 20 at 6000 x g and 12 °C for 3 minutes.
Repeat this washing step 3 times.
Incubate the Vivaspin 20 overnight at 4 °C, then collect the final sample (1 mL).

steps.title: Quantify RNA and DNA
steps.instruction: Determine the concentrations of RNA and DNA using a Qubit 4 fluorimeter.

substeps.instruction: Quantify RNA concentration using the RNA BR Assay kit (detection range 10 to 1200 ng).
Quantify DNA concentration using the dsDNA BR Assay kit (detection range 4 to 2000 ng).
